entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I'm calling about an order. I'm just so disappointed. I need to make a return.
I'm sorry to hear that you're disappointed. I can certainly help you with a return. To start, could you tell me your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Yes, it's sarah.vip@email.com. It was for that beautiful blue cycling jersey. I've been a loyal customer for years and I've never had a problem before.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your account and the order right here. You've definitely been with us for a while, and we really appreciate that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's the wrong size. I waited so long to even try it on, I was saving it for a special ride. And when I finally did, it was just... way too tight. I feel so silly for waiting. I was hoping for an exchange, but I think it's been too long and I really needed this money back for the holidays.

I completely understand. It's no problem at all. Let me just check the delivery date here... okay, I see it was delivered about 70 days ago. Our policy for standard items like this jersey is a 90-day return window, so you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, really? Are you sure? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

Absolutely sure. I've just initiated the return for you and sent a prepaid shipping label to your email. You can just print that out, attach it to the package, and drop it at any post office. We can either process a full refund to your original payment method, or if you'd still like to exchange it for a different size, I can help with that.
You know what, a refund would be wonderful right now. Thank you so much, David. You've really helped me out.

It's my pleasure, Sarah. And as a thank you for being such a valued VIP member, I've also added a free express shipping credit to your account for your next order. Hopefully, you can find another jersey that's a perfect fit.
Wow, that's so kind of you! Thank you! That makes me feel a lot better. I'll definitely be looking at your new collection soon. You've been a great help.
Happy to assist. Once we receive the returned item, you'll see the refund in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, David!
You're very welcome. Have a great day and happy holidays!
